name: verify_manifest
command:
import os,resource; os.sched_setaffinity(0,sorted(os.sched_getaffinity(0))[:2]); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_CPU,(115,115)); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_AS,(6*1024**3,6*1024**3));
import json, os, hashlib
m=json.load(open("MANIFEST.json",encoding="utf-8"))
print("count field",m["count"],"len files",len(m["files"]),"credit",m["credit"])
print("exclusions",m["terminal_noncircular_self_exclusions"])
bad=[]
for f in m["files"]:
    if not os.path.exists(f["path"]):
        bad.append(("missing",f["path"])); continue
    b=open(f["path"],"rb").read()
    if len(b)!=f["bytes"]: bad.append(("bytes",f["path"],len(b),f["bytes"]))
    h=hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest()
    if h!=f["sha256"]: bad.append(("sha",f["path"]))
print("bad",bad[:10],"nbad",len(bad))
for t in ["MANIFEST.json","seal_manifest.receipt.json","seal_manifest.output.txt"]:
    print(t,"exists",os.path.exists(t),"in files",any(f["path"]==t for f in m["files"]))
print("sample paths:",[f["path"] for f in m["files"][:8]])
print("pdf entry:",[f for f in m["files"] if f["path"]=="output/pdf/bunkbed-transitive-tournaments.pdf"])
print("source entry:",[f for f in m["files"] if f["path"]=="source/bunkbed-transitive-tournaments.roff"])
print("qa entry:",[f for f in m["files"] if f["path"]=="qa/QA.json"])
print("claims entry:",[f for f in m["files"] if f["path"]=="CLAIMS.json"])
